resolution.note: frozen-matrix test: 12-row rep-99 mixed-harness fixture refused (exit 65), complete not-shown fixture accepted; fails without the source change

title: A/B/C report refuses an incomplete or mixed matrix before significance
body:
Astra audit E1/E2/E5 (verified): evals/replay/abc.ts analyze (90-108) declares a contrast shown without checking matrix completeness, reps, harness or model; missing cost becomes 0 (evals/replay/arm-session.ts:131) and ungraded spend drops out of dollars per resolution (abc.ts:113-117); rows carry no realized model (evals/replay/rows.ts:7-15) and the revision hash covers replay-directory .ts only (rows.ts:17-26).
Files: evals/replay/abc.ts, evals/replay/rows.ts, evals/replay/arm-session.ts, evals/replay/run.ts, test/evals/frozen-matrix.test.ts
Outcome: --report --strict exits non-zero on an incomplete or mixed matrix (missing cells, duplicate reps, mixed harness or realized model) before any significance test; unknown cost stays null and is reported, never 0; rows record the realized model; a complete matrix whose result is not shown is accepted.
Proof: node --test test/evals/frozen-matrix.test.ts passes, rejecting a 12-row rep-99 mixed-harness fixture and accepting a complete not-shown fixture.
